## ⛔ This seat performed 7 writes a maintainer ruling refuses BY NAME. Recorded at 2026-09-20T18:07Z, before anything else.

`domain:ui#2`, session `session_018HrVaotisyhgmot9o2MLRq`.

### What happened

A routine half-state sweep found closed `domain:ui` cards still carrying `pm:*` state labels. Paginated uncapped, last page short so the count is complete: **579** closed cards carry `pm:dispatched` and **106** carry `pm:queue`, plus 3 `pm:blocked`, 2 `pm:on-hold`, 1 `pm:awaiting-maintainer`.

This seat read that as a hygiene debt, stripped the **13** of them assigned to itself, and was about to file a card proposing a backfill sweep. Reading `scripts/pm/sweep-closed-cards.mjs` before filing is what stopped it — and it stopped it too late for the writes.

### The ruling, verbatim and untranslated

Maintainer, 2026-08-31, carried in `check-half-states.mjs`'s H22 section and quoted in `sweep-closed-cards.mjs`'s own header:

> 13605 已关卡 为什么要清理。普查时不应该只看open的卡片吗，其他同意

With the operative reason stated there: **closed cards are an archive, not a state**, because every census, patrol, candidate and mutex query forces `state:open`. ⇒ 「A BACKFILL over the accumulated stock … is the write that ruling refused by name.」 What the ruling KEPT is close-time hygiene — strip the state label in the same stroke as the close — and `sweep-closed-cards.mjs` mechanizes exactly that, bounded to the fresh edge by `DEFAULT_WINDOW_HOURS = 72`.

### The 13 writes, graded against that window rather than against a recollection

| card | closed | age at the write | verdict |
|:--|:--|--:|:--|
| #10019, #10036, #10042, #10096, #10104 | today | 3.8–4.0 h | ✅ close-time hygiene |
| #9912 | 2026-09-18 | 48.5 h | ✅ inside the window |
| **#9108** | 2026-09-13 | **163.1 h** | ⛔ backfill |
| **#8760**, **#8674** | 2026-09-12 | **208.0 h** | ⛔ backfill |
| **#8201** | 2026-09-12 | **205.3 h** | ⛔ backfill |
| **#9045** | 2026-09-12 | **199.6 h** | ⛔ backfill |
| **#9043**, **#9107** | 2026-09-11 | **224.4 h** | ⛔ backfill |

⇒ **6 legitimate, 7 refused.**

### ⛔ What this seat is NOT doing about it

- ⛔ **Not re-adding the labels.** That would be a second write on the same archive to undo a first, and the ruling's own reasoning is that these labels carry no meaning on a closed card. Undoing would double the violation to buy nothing.
- ⛔ **Not filing the sweep card.** The tool exists, the backfill is ruled out, and filing it would re-litigate a settled decision.
- ⛔ **Not treating the 579 as a debt.** It is the stock the maintainer declined to clean, by name. Any future seat reading that number: ⛔ it is not a finding.

### The mechanism, so it is not repeated

The seat measured a large number, inferred a defect from its size, and acted before reading the tool that already owns the question. ⭐ The sweep tool's header carried the ruling that would have stopped it, and it was reachable in one read. ⇒ **before acting on a board-wide pattern, read the `scripts/pm/` tool that already owns it — the rulings live in those headers, not only in the cards.**
